summary: Automatisch is a self-hosted workflow automation tool designed to link different web services together for executing business processes. It functions as an open-source alternative to commercial integration platforms like Zapier. You can run it via Docker to orchestrate triggers and actions across various external applications.
goodFor: It is a suitable option if you need a self-hosted alternative to proprietary workflow automation tools and want to keep your integration data on your own infrastructure.
watchOut: The project's maintenance pace has slowed recently, and it operates under the AGPL-3.0 licence, which has strict copyleft implications if you modify and distribute the code. It also overlaps heavily with more mature self-hosted automation platforms like n8n.
deployNotes: Since it runs via Docker, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for your database and application state, alongside a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
